scoring_justification: Recompute infeasible: the full Lu‑Grover model computation cannot be re‑run in the verifier sandbox. Compare against paper‑reported Cp values from Fig. 1.

outputs.description: Isobaric heat capacity of β-Sn at 300 K for pressures 1×10⁵, 5×10⁹, 1×10¹⁰, and 1.5×10¹⁰ Pa. Values are compared to reference values within a tolerance to confirm the negative Cp anomaly above ~10 GPa.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the submitted Cp values at 300 K against the paper-reported reference values (extracted from Fig. 1) and verifies that Cp is negative at 10 GPa and above. The agent must implement the full computation; the c parameter is provided as a constant.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Cp values for β‑Sn at 300 K from the paper's Fig. 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Fig. 1 of the paper (Lu‑Grover model Cp of β‑Sn at the specified pressures)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the plotted curves; confirmed by the reference solve.sh constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values needed to verify reproduction of the negative-Cp anomaly.
